findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "plan_project" is 2623 chars, far longer than this server's median (115). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Use this first whenever the user is building something ("build me a CRM", "make a landing page", "add a chatbot to my app"). It returns the directory's AI tools…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_project, search_resources, list_categories · Private data: plan_project, search_resources · Public sink: plan_project, search_resources.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_project, search_resources, list_categories · Private data: plan_project, search_resources · Public sink: plan_project, search_resources

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
